phases.name: safety
phases.notes: Dirty worktree preserved. Production save hashes matched before and after. Disposable data only.

phases.name: trace
phases.notes: Browser and HTTP already reached chat(). Production chat did not call the PR-DO/PR-DR interpreter until this connector.

phases.name: integration
phases.notes: game/live_chat_interpretation.py reuses the existing prompt, schema, adapter, and PR-DU bridge. Accepted actions are locked. Rejected results do not fall through.

phases.name: communication_modes
phases.notes: Explicit IC, explicit OOC, and AUTO exercised. Explicit OOC made no provider call. AUTO rules question was OUT_OF_CHARACTER and non-mutating.

phases.name: provider_controls
phases.notes: Pin gpt-4.1-mini. Retries disabled. Limit 6 requests, 8000 input, 2000 output, 10000 total.

phases.name: preflight
phases.notes: Providers disabled. Frontend, start, explicit OOC non-mutating, explicit IC discover_clue. See preflight_http.json. Runtime then replaced before live calls.
